system.name: Gateway Offloading System
system.description: A system implementing the Gateway Offloading pattern.

gateway.name: Gateway Offloading
gateway.description: A pattern where a gateway handles some requests itself (offloading) instead of forwarding them to backend services.

N_A.description: Number of users of type A.

N_B.description: Number of users of type B.

r_Z_A.description: Rate of think time for users of type A.

r_Z_B.description: Rate of think time for users of type B.

r_A_s1.description: Service rate for service s1 (type A).

r_B_s2.description: Service rate for service s2 (type B).

r_B_s3.description: Service rate for service s3 (type B).

offloading_strategy.description: The strategy for which services are offloaded at the gateway, based on their service time.

short-services-offloaded.description: Services with short processing times are offloaded (S_gw = 5).

long-services-offloaded.description: Services with long processing times are offloaded (S_gw = 10).

quality_objectives.name: response_time
quality_objectives.description: The end-to-end time to serve a request.

quality_objectives.name: utilization
quality_objectives.description: The utilization of the gateway resource.
